description: This file defines a Swift actor class 'CameraController' that manages camera and microphone access, captures photos and videos, handles permissions, lists available camera devices, and performs media transcoding. It integrates with AVFoundation and custom support modules to provide camera functionalities for an iOS application.

classes.name: CameraDeviceInfo
classes.description: Data structure representing camera device information such as id, name, position, and device type.

classes.name: CameraError
classes.description: Enumeration of potential camera-related errors with localized descriptions.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Asynchronously captures a photo with specified parameters and returns its format, base64 string, width, and height.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Asynchronously records a video clip with specified parameters and returns its format, base64 string, duration, and audio presence.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices with their details.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests access permissions for video or audio media types.
